taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-b-item

parts.text:
Curve-type notation for vertical electrical sounding (VES): take the layer resistivities in depth order. For each group of three consecutive layers (layers 1-2-3, then 2-3-4, and so on), write one letter: A if r1 < r2 < r3; Q if r1 > r2 > r3; H if r1 > r2 < r3; K if r1 < r2 > r3. A curve with N layers gets N-2 letters, in depth order (for example, a 4-layer curve gets 2 letters, such as HA). If all the letters are the same, the curve may also be written as that single letter (AAA may be written A).

Station T-28, survey area T. Interpreted layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 853.6 | 0.80 | 0.80
2 | 1156.2 | 1.92 | 2.72
3 | 234.7 | 7.57 | 10.29
4 | 2817.0 | 39.25 | 49.54
5 | 234.7 | - | -

What is the curve type of this station? Give a short answer, then end with one JSON line exactly like this:
{"curve_type": "<letters>"}

To determine the curve-type notation for station T-28, we analyze the resistivity values of the five layers in depth order:
$\rho_1 = 853.6$
$\rho_2 = 1156.2$
$\rho_3 = 234.7$
$\rho_4 = 2817.0$
$\rho_5 = 234.7$

Since there are 5 layers, the notation will consist of $5 - 2 = 3$ letters, corresponding to three groups of three consecutive layers:

1.  **Layers 1-2-3:** $\rho_1=853.6$, $\rho_2=1156.2$, $\rho_3=234.7$.
    Comparing them: $853.6 < 1156.2 > 234.7$ ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$).
    This corresponds to the letter **K**.

2.  **Layers 2-3-4:** $\rho_2=1156.2$, $\rho_3=234.7$, $\rho_4=2817.0$.
    Comparing them: $1156.2 > 234.7 < 2817.0$ ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3$).
    This corresponds to the letter **H**.

3.  **Layers 3-4-5:** $\rho_3=234.7$, $\rho_4=2817.0$, $\rho_5=234.7$.
    Comparing them: $234.7 < 2817.0 > 234.7$ ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3$).
    This corresponds to the letter **K**.

Combining these letters in depth order, we get **KHK**.

{"curve_type": "KHK"}
